customer: Freelance graphic designers in Egypt and the wider MENA region who work with several clients at once
problem: Freelance graphic designers in Egypt need a way to track client projects, invoices sent, and revision rounds.
solution: A digital template pack (Notion and Google Sheets) that helps freelance graphic designers in Egypt track client projects, invoices sent, and revision rounds.
value_proposition: A bilingual (Arabic and English) digital template pack built for local freelancing habits, with no subscriptions and no client data collection.

hypotheses.text: Freelance graphic designers in Egypt and the MENA region will pay USD 100 for a digital template pack that helps them track client projects, invoices sent, and revision rounds.
hypotheses.test: Create a landing page with a one-time purchase link and track how many clicks and sign-ups occur within a week.

hypotheses.text: Freelance graphic designers in Egypt and the MENA region will use a Notion and Google Sheets template pack to track client projects, invoices sent, and revision rounds.
hypotheses.test: Survey 10 freelance designers in Egypt and the MENA region to understand their current workflow and whether they would use a template pack for tracking.

hypotheses.text: Freelance graphic designers in Egypt and the MENA region will prefer a bilingual (Arabic and English) template pack over one that is only in English.
hypotheses.test: Create two versions of the template pack—one in Arabic and one in English—and ask 10 freelance designers in Egypt and the MENA region to choose their preferred version.

hypotheses.text: Freelance graphic designers in Egypt and the MENA region will not collect client data when using the template pack.
hypotheses.test: Survey 10 freelance designers in Egypt and the MENA region to understand their data privacy concerns and whether they would use a template pack that does not collect client data.
